title: Not subject to levy.
bodyText: No judgment creditor or other claimant of an insurer shall levy upon any deposit held pursuant to this article or upon any part hereof.
bodyHtml: §431:7-311  Not subject to levy.  No judgment creditor or other claimant of an insurer shall levy upon any deposit held pursuant to this article or upon any part hereof. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
